O histórico de campanhas, visitas e vend: The history of campaigns, visits and sales does not have automatic deletion by deadline in this version. It is kept as long as necessary for the operation and may be subject to a request for deletion or anonymization. Disconnecting from Meta removes the connection token from WeTrack, but does not automatically delete the already imported history. Records that need to be kept due to legal obligation or exercise of rights may be retained with restricted access.
O painel usa um cookie de sessão para au: The dashboard uses a session cookie for authentication and stores preferences such as theme and selected operation. The Meta connection flow uses a temporary cookie to validate authorization. The pixel maintains a visitor identifier in the browser's local storage, last click for seven days, first origin for thirty days, and a session renewed after thirty minutes of inactivity. The visitor identifier remains until removed from site storage.
O pedido pode abranger tokens da integra: The request may cover Meta integration tokens, data imported from authorized accounts, visit records, and personal sales data related to the requester. Data from third parties or other operations will not be deleted without adequate basis and authorization.

You must also inform visitors, establish an adequate basis for the processing and obtain authorizations when necessary. Do not send data obtained improperly or that is not necessary for the integration purposes.
O responsável pelo site integrado deve a: The person responsible for the integrated website must present the privacy options and obtain consent when applicable. These permissions are not automatically obtained by installing the pixel.
O script instalado recebe as melhorias a: The installed script receives the improvements automatically.
O serviço pode passar por manutenção, aj: The service may undergo maintenance, adjustments and interruptions. Third-party APIs and services may also change or become unavailable. Features and integrations can be updated; Material changes to these terms will be reflected at this address.

Quando houver obrigação legal ou necessi: When there is a legal obligation or need to exercise rights, part of the records may be kept with restricted access.
